app_error_description: Charon could not render this shelf. Your workspace was not changed.
capture_help_double_shift_description: Capture selected text from another app.
capture_help_composer_description: Show Charon and place the cursor in the composer.
workspace_empty_description: Charon keeps notes in a local folder you control.
workspace_error_description: Charon stopped before changing files. Reopen the workspace or use recovery.
workspace_warning: Showing the last valid workspace while a recoverable issue needs attention.
note_empty_all_description: Add a note below or capture selected text from another app.
note_empty_search_description_flat: Clear the search or active tag to see more notes.
note_empty_search_description: Try fewer words or clear the status filter.
note_editor_save_error: The note was not saved. Your draft is preserved; retry after resolving the workspace issue.
copy_local_paths_disclosure: Managed local Attachment paths enter the clipboard; Attachment bytes never do.
clipboard_error_empty_selection: Select at least one note before copying.
clipboard_error_all_bodies_empty: Every selected note is empty, so nothing was written.
clipboard_error_invalid_request: The selection changed before copy. Review it and retry.
clipboard_error_permission_denied: Clipboard write access was denied. Allow it in system settings, then retry.
clipboard_error_platform_unavailable: Clipboard writing is unavailable on this platform. Your selection is preserved.
clipboard_error_write_failed: Couldn’t copy. Your selection is still here. Try again.
clipboard_error_workspace_unavailable: The current workspace could not be verified. Reopen it, then retry.
workspace_error_stale_revision: The workspace changed outside this view. The latest version is loaded; review it and retry.
workspace_error_invalid_path: The selected path is outside the workspace or is not a supported local path.
workspace_error_invalid_manifest: The workspace manifest is invalid. Charon kept the last valid state and did not write changes.
workspace_error_unsupported_schema: This workspace was created by an unsupported schema version. Open it with a compatible Charon version.
workspace_error_validation: The requested change violates a workspace rule. Review the note and section state, then retry.
workspace_error_io: The local files could not be read or written. Check folder access and available disk space, then retry.
workspace_error_recovery_required: An interrupted workspace transaction requires local recovery before more changes can be saved.
workspace_error_deletion_cleanup_require: The notes were removed, but transaction cleanup could not be verified. Retry cleanup before relying on permanent deletion.
workspace_error_legacy_archive_collision: Migration stopped because legacy-trash-v1 already exists. Move or rename that user-owned folder, then reopen the workspace.
workspace_error_not_found: A note or section used by this action no longer exists. The latest workspace state is displayed.
workspace_error_runtime_lock: The local workspace is temporarily busy. No files were changed; retry in a moment.
delete_description: This permanently removes the selected Markdown and managed attachments. It cannot be undone.
delete_external_boundary: Operating-system snapshots, external backups, and synced histories are outside Charon’s deletion guarantee.
delete_error: The notes were not deleted. Your selection is preserved; retry.
delete_cleanup_required: The notes were removed, but cleanup could not be verified. Retry cleanup before relying on permanent deletion.
capture_input_error: The note was not added. Your text is preserved; retry after resolving the workspace issue.
tag_error_duplicate: That tag is already on this note.
tag_error_limit: A note can have at most 16 tags.
tag_error_invalid: Use 1–48 visible characters without line breaks or controls.
attachment_remove_description: {file} will be deleted from this note and cannot be recovered.
attachment_remove_error: The attachment could not be removed. Nothing was reported as complete.
attachment_import_error: The attachment was not imported. The note and selected files were left unchanged.
capture_error_invalid_shortcut: That shortcut is not valid. The previous shortcut remains active.
capture_error_shortcut_registration: The shortcut is already used or could not be registered. The visible capture command still works.
capture_error_shortcut_unregistration: The previous shortcut could not be removed safely. Retry before changing it.
capture_error_listener_unavailable: The enhanced capture listener could not start. Use the standard shortcut.
capture_error_worker_unavailable: The bounded capture worker could not start. Use the standard shortcut or manual input.
capture_error_permission_denied: A required capture permission is denied. The standard shortcut and manual input remain available.
capture_input_monitoring_description: Required only to observe the double-Shift modifier sequence in other apps. Charon never records your typing.
capture_accessibility_description: Reads the focused or pointer-targeted accessible selection after double Shift. If direct access returns no text, Charon may invoke the source app’s Copy command once; the selection can briefly appear on the system clipboard and be seen by a clipboard manager. Charon restores the previous contents only when no concurrent write occurred, never monitors clipboard history, never posts Paste, and never uploads content.
capture_error_selection_unsupported: Selected-text capture is unsupported here. Enter Markdown manually.
capture_error_selection_failed: This app did not expose a readable selection through Accessibility or its Copy command. Nothing was saved; enter Markdown manually.
capture_warning_clipboard_not_restored: Charon did not overwrite a newer clipboard value, or macOS rejected safe restoration. The captured note may still have been saved; review the clipboard before pasting.
capture_error_main_editor_unavailable: The main note editor could not be revealed. Your workspace was not changed.
capture_error_shutdown: Capture is shutting down. Reopen Charon to register the shortcut again.
capture_error_runtime_lock: Capture is temporarily busy. Retry in a moment.
capture_error_unknown: Capture encountered an unexpected local error. Your workspace was not changed.
preferences_description: Appearance, language, notes folder, and capture.
preferences_workspace_local: Your notes stay in this folder, on this device.
preferences_workspace_draft_blocked: Finish saving the open draft before changing folders.
preferences_portable_description: Shows Charon and places the cursor in the composer.
preferences_platform_fallback: Selected-text capture is not claimed on this platform. The portable shortcut and manual composer remain available.
preferences_error: Local preferences could not be refreshed. Existing settings remain active.
preferences_error_invalid_path: The remembered folder is invalid. Choose another local folder.
preferences_error_unsupported_schema: These preferences come from a newer Charon version.
preferences_error_invalid_value: That preference value is not supported.
preferences_error_io: Preferences could not be saved locally. Check folder permissions and retry.
preferences_error_encoding: Preferences could not be encoded safely.
capture_hint: On this Mac, select text and press Shift twice to capture one local Note.
